fact: A 2022 report states that under Decree 2021-017 the social security card, retirees' card and PNSF beneficiary card ceased to be valid after 31 December 2021 and had to be renewed through the national register of persons (RNPP), with the CNSS card to become biometric.
title: La carte d'identité biométrique : Un saut dans la modernité et l'innovation
